groups.title: chemistry
groups.note: The names of elements and compounds: a metal, fire or flesh part plus a shape that carries the name.

chars.story: A stone that glimmers in the dark: phosphorus.
The metal in bones and chalk: calcium.
A hydrocarbon that burns easily: an alkene.
A sweet-smelling liquid first got from plant resins: benzene.
A compound found in flesh and rot: an amine.
The agent that makes wine ferment: an enzyme.

groups.title: mouth 口
groups.note: A mouth on the left: noises, calls and the throat.

chars.story: A mouth pursed to blow: a whistle.
Breath let out slowly through the mouth: a hiss.
A mouth snapping out a short bang, like a horn.
A mouth making a short loud cry, like a duck.
A mouth that drives in like a nail: a sting or bite.
A mouth that makes no sound: mute.
A dragon-sized tube behind the mouth: the throat.
chars.note: Only in 喉咙. 嚨 became 咙.

chars.story: Food put into a small mouth: feed a baby.

groups.title: hand 扌
groups.note: A hand on the left: grasping, mixing, pushing.

chars.story: A hand striking out with words: verbal attack.
A hand sweeping everything toward you: take on.
Hands joined together in a curve: an arch.
A hand mixing half and half: mix in.
A hand working something soft: knead.
Hands drawing things in close: draw in.
A hand giving out a feeling: express it.

groups.title: metal 钅
groups.note: Metal on the left: tools, weapons, ore.

chars.story: A small piece of metal thrown at a target: a dart.
Metal gone red and flaky: rust.
Metal rings locked on a prisoner: shackles.
Metal set into a surface to hold a gem: inlay.

groups.title: water 氵
groups.note: Three drops on the left: flow, soak, flood.

chars.story: Water brought to the fields: irrigate.
chars.note: Only in 灌溉 'irrigate', as the second half of the word.

chars.story: Water stirred into a dish till it is cloudy: mix up.
Water heaving into big waves.
Like water poured together: agreement.

groups.title: trees 木
groups.note: A tree on the left: wood and wooden things.

chars.parts: 木 wood + 疏 spread out (sound)
chars.story: A wooden tool that spreads the hair out: a comb.
Two thorn plants, one over the other: thorns.
The sharp ridge on a squared beam: a corner edge.
A thin slip of wood to write on.
chars.note: Old word; mostly in 札记.

groups.title: grass 艹
groups.note: Grass on top: plants and what grows wild.

chars.story: Grass growing where nothing else is: overgrown.
A plant that droops: wither.

chars.parts: 艹 grass + 冖 cover + 虫 insect
chars.story: An insect glowing in the grass at night: a firefly.
A jewel-like growth from the sea: coral.
A jewel that glows like honey: amber.

chars.parts: 王 jade + 小 small + 贝 shell
chars.story: Little bits of jade and shell: trifles.

groups.title: woman 女
groups.note: A woman on the left: family, charm, names.

chars.story: The man who comes with a woman's marriage: son-in-law.
A woman with lovely brows: charming.
A woman's name ending, as in Julia.
chars.note: A transliteration character, mostly in foreign women's names. 婭 became 娅.

chars.story: A field cut in half by a line: the riverbank beside it.
Breaking up wild earth to farm: reclaim.
Earth where a town once stood, now empty: ruins.
The trigram of earth, stretching flat.
chars.note: 乾坤 is the pair 'heaven and earth'.

chars.story: The body of a person, trunk and all.
The pale spirit that stays with the body: the bodily soul.
chars.note: The body-bound soul, not the roaming one.

chars.story: The body part at the end of the tube.
The wooden-looking stack of bones down the back.
The bird that lays: female.
A young pig, soft flesh: a suckling pig.
chars.note: Meet it mostly in 海豚 and 河豚.

chars.story: An animal lying in wait: ambush.
A tiny insect marching in line: an ant.
chars.note: 螞 became 蚂. Only in these words. The first half of 蚂蚁 'ant', always with 蚁.

chars.story: The stripes on a tiger's coat.

groups.title: people
groups.note: A person on the left: leaning, stooping, waiting.

chars.story: A person standing at the side: nearby.
A person bending forward to look below.
A person who stands ready to serve: wait on.

groups.title: heart 忄
groups.note: A heart on the left: fear, hate, grief.

chars.story: A heart that starts at any change: fearful.
A heart turned against something: detest.

chars.parts: 罒 net + 忄 heart + 隹 bird
chars.story: A heart caught in a net like a bird: struck by misfortune.
chars.note: Used in formal writing, about illness or disaster.

chars.story: Words that set one thing beside another: give an example.
Words said behind someone's back: slander.
A mouth that tells you again to do it: instruct.
A mouth drawing out a long line of verse.
An offering laid on the altar: a ritual offering.
The blessed pay from the ruler: an official salary.
The covering worn on a ruler's head: a royal crown.
What an emperor calls himself: the royal 'we'.
chars.note: Only used by emperors; you will meet it in historical stories.

chars.story: A trap set in a stream below a hill.
chars.note: In practice a place-name character: Shantou, Shanwei.

chars.parts: 阝 mound + 左 left + 月 flesh
chars.story: The short dynasty that reunited China before the Tang.

chars.parts: 阝 mound + 反 turn back
chars.story: A mound where the ground turns back down: a slope.
chars.note: Meet it in Japanese place names, as in 大阪. Literary 'slope' (also 坂); today you meet it in 大阪 'Osaka'.

chars.story: Fields laid out in town blocks.
A hand striking with a clawed weapon; today it survives in one country's name.
chars.note: Only in 老挝, Laos. 撾 became 挝.

groups.title: food and cooking
groups.note: Things that go in a pot.

chars.story: Food worked on until ready: cook.
The soft round bread of the north.
chars.note: 饅 became 馒. Only in 馒头.

chars.story: Wine gone sour: vinegar.
chars.note: 吃醋 'eat vinegar' means to be jealous.

chars.story: A hole that only the clever know how to find.
A hole bent into the hillside: a grotto.

groups.title: bamboo ⺮
groups.note: Bamboo on top: flutes and books.

chars.story: A hollow length of bamboo you blow across: a flute.
Bamboo slips tied together to record accounts: a register.
Safe leather seat on a horse: a saddle.

chars.parts: 罒 net + 马 horse + 革 leather strip
chars.story: A net of leather strips over a horse's head: a bridle.
A knife with a dot marking the edge: the blade.
Leather that a blade cannot cut: tough.

chars.parts: 日 sun + 未 not yet
chars.story: The sun not yet up: dim and hidden.
An eye turning toward you: a glance.
chars.note: Only in 青睐. 睞 became 睐.

chars.parts: - an arrow with its feathers and head
chars.story: An arrow with head and tail feathers.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'arrow'. In modern prose it survives in 矢志 and 矢量. The literary word for 箭.

chars.story: Make a bent arrow straight: rectify.
Four mouths shouting around a head: clamor.
Mouths crying out in alarm: a dreadful omen.
Tapping something out flat to cover a surface: spread on.

chars.parts: 户 door + 聿 brush + 攵 tap
chars.story: A door opened, a first stroke made: begin.
chars.note: Used in formal reports of accidents.

chars.story: A sweet scent filling the room: warm and cozy.
chars.note: Mostly 温馨 'warm and cozy'; 馨香 is 'fragrance'.

chars.story: Soft thread like short pile: velvet.
A stalk on legs with nothing on top: bald.
Small bits shed from a body: crumbs.

groups.title: single shapes
groups.note: Three odd characters that stand alone.

chars.story: Two things wrapped together in equal shares: evenly.
A stem that forks into two: a forked branch.
The twelfth of the earthly branches, once pictured as a pig.
chars.note: Meet it in 辛亥革命, the 1911 Revolution.

sentences.en: The King of France is bald.
The bodyguard was wearing an earpiece.
He writes poems in the early-evening hours.

sentences.zh: 真的不敢相信你在吃医生叮嘱不要食用的东西。
sentences.en: I can't believe you are eating something the doctor has told you repeatedly you shouldn't eat.
